problem: The owner-VPS is alive, but the observed /workspace checkout is stale and dirty. Current supervisor counterevidence forbids promotion-bearing runtime credit from that checkout and explicitly requires a clean exact-source disposable worktree/container or byte-identical source proof while preserving the dirty worker workspace.

observed_authority_drift: telemetry/RUN_PACKAGE_CONTRACT.md says the active ABI is runpackages/RUN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA_V1.json / FRANKENSTEIN2_IMMUTABLE_RUN_PACKAGE/v1 and describes closure-style schemas as historical donors
at F2 commit 068f4551d1a7f1318e7ea39721772f155f48c6dc the runpackages directory contains README.md and verify_run_package.py but no RUN_PACKAGE_SCHEMA_V1.json
runpackages/README.md says the opposite: manifest.json + ARTIFACTS.json + SHA256SUMS + CLOSED.json is canonical and the single-MANIFEST immutable package is historical

runpackages/verify_run_package.py actually enforces FRANKENSTEIN2_RUN_PACKAGE_MANIFEST/v1 plus ARTIFACTS/SHA256SUMS/CLOSED and validates source_commit_before/source_commit_after, but has no source-tree or execution-root byte-manifest field
tests/test_verify_run_package.py exercise the closure-style verifier with source_commit_before/source_commit_after rather than the prose-described missing ABI
source_archaeology.consequence: Trigger4 must reconcile the WP004 authority surfaces against the executable verifier before extending the run-package ABI. Trigger6 must not create a competing package authority.

primary_external_sources.mapped_mechanism: git worktree add --detach <path> <commit-ish> creates a separate detached checkout suitable for testing without disturbing an existing dirty worktree
--porcelain=v2 is script-oriented and stable; --untracked-files=all enumerates individual untracked files; --ignore-submodules=none avoids silently hiding dirty submodule state
checkout clean/smudge/text/ident transformations mean Git object/tree identity and a clean status do not by themselves prove raw worktree byte identity

primary_external_sources.source: SLSA provenance v1 model (analogy only, not a compliance claim)
primary_external_sources.mapped_mechanism: bind execution inputs/dependencies and digests into explicit provenance rather than infer them from a path name

hypothesis: A non-destructive disposable detached worktree plus explicit commit/tree equality, machine-readable dirty-state exclusion, and a deterministic manifest over the actual runtime source bytes can close the execution-root identity gap without resetting the existing dirty workspace or importing a heavyweight integrity framework.

counterhypotheses.claim: Recording a Git commit in the existing run package is already enough.
counterhypotheses.resolution: FALSIFIED_AT_ARCHITECTURE_SCOPE: current supervisor evidence observed a stale dirty execution checkout while F2 evidence surfaces can still carry source commit strings. The verifier does not bind the actual executing worktree tree/bytes.

counterhypotheses.claim: A clean Git status plus HEAD commit is byte-identity proof.
counterhypotheses.resolution: REJECTED_AS_TOO_STRONG: Git attributes can transform checkout bytes; therefore actual source bytes must be digested separately when byte identity matters.

counterhypotheses.claim: Mandatory fs-verity is the right baseline solution.
counterhypotheses.resolution: NOT_SELECTED: concurrent Trigger6 evidence R6-WP510-FSVERITY-EXACTSOURCE-001 reached E3 and concluded fs-verity should remain optional defense-in-depth; process consumption binding belongs in the separate WP1207 ReleaseConsumptionWitness.

layering.layer_1_execution_root: This research: requested commit/tree -> separate detached worktree -> clean-state proof -> actual source-byte manifest before/after -> run receipt.
layering.layer_2_consumed_bytes: Concurrent R6-WP510-FSVERITY-EXACTSOURCE-001: acquire once, hash and consume the same bytes at loader/import boundary. This is complementary, not duplicated authority.
layering.layer_3_run_package: F2-WP-004 packages the evidence at declared scope after its current authority drift is reconciled.

source_manifest_rules: hash deterministic path/type/mode/size/SHA-256 records for actual runtime-relevant files, excluding only explicitly declared Git administrative metadata/output roots
record symlink targets and reject or separately authorize paths that escape the execution root
treat submodules and checkout/content filters as explicit identity surfaces rather than silently inheriting parent-tree credit
keep writable outputs/logs/state outside the source root when feasible
recompute after execution; any mismatch taints promotion credit

limitations_and_falsifiers: Pre/post manifests bound the source state before and after the run but do not by themselves exclude a transient mid-run mutation; stronger same-object consumption or an actually read-only source mount is needed for that stronger claim.
This execution-root proof does not prove that a model/loader consumed the verified bytes; the concurrent ReleaseConsumptionWitness addresses that separate layer.

If Trigger4 discovers an already-current executable F2 primitive that proves requested commit/tree, clean-state exclusion and actual source bytes at the exact execution root, reduce this candidate to receipt/schema reconciliation instead of adding a duplicate runner.
If WP004 canonical authority is repaired to a different successor ABI before integration, this result becomes STALE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and must be remapped rather than force-fitted.
